# Website Quality Audit: Screenshot Analysis

## Overall Layout
The screenshot displays a single-page section of what appears to be a catering or event planning website with a dark theme. The layout is clean and modern, featuring a hero section with three images arranged horizontally at the top, followed by a centered call-to-action section, and a footer at the bottom.

## Color Scheme
- **Background**: Deep black (#000000) creates a sophisticated, elegant atmosphere
- **Text**: White for primary text, with "мероприятие" in a gold/amber accent color
- **Button**: Golden yellow (#D4AF37) for the call-to-action button
- **Footer**: Slightly lighter black or dark gray background

## Typography
- **Primary heading**: "Заказать мероприятие" uses a serif font (likely Georgia or similar) with "Заказать" in white and "мероприятие" in gold
- **Subheading**: Smaller, lighter sans-serif font in white
- **Button text**: Uppercase sans-serif font in dark color
- **Footer text**: Small sans-serif font in gray

## Spacing & Hierarchy
- Generous vertical spacing between the image row and text content
- Consistent horizontal spacing between the three images
- Clear visual hierarchy with the heading as the most prominent element
- Ample white space around the call-to-action button

## Images
Three high-quality, professional photographs:
1. Left: Bar scene with champagne glasses and fruit
2. Center: Seafood platter with oysters and shrimp
3. Right: Formal table setting with glassware and plates

All images appear to be properly sized and cropped, with consistent dimensions and rounded corners.

## Visual Issues/Concerns
- No obvious visual issues or errors in this section
- The layout appears responsive-friendly
- Color contrast meets accessibility standards
- Images are relevant to the catering/event theme

## Footer Elements
- Company information: "ИП Нинов Д.И. ИНН 781643753900 · Nilov Catering · © 2014-2026"
- Navigation links: "О компании", "Политика конфиденциальности", "Контакты"
- Small logo or icon in the bottom left corner

The overall design effectively communicates luxury and professionalism appropriate for a high-end catering service.
